defects.claim: Resting a forearm on the bent knee (NOT arms overhead)
defects.evidence: PR-v4 source comment confirms shoulders forced to -110 (overhead) as too-subtle auto-fix. Description requires forearm-on-knee contact. L shoulder abducted 127°, R shoulder abducted 155° — both overhead. Both elbow_above_shoulder anomalies flagged. R shoulder plausibility flag: sagittal flexion -143° outside band. Same defect class as cross-ankle-sit (batch 1) and p15-chair-s6 (this batch).

defects.evidence: L wrist at (-0.514, 1.084, 0.592), L knee at (0.322, 0.064, 0.174). L wrist-to-L-knee 3D distance 1.384 (should be <0.30 for forearm-on-knee contact). shoulderFwdL:+15 = BEHIND per corrected convention (wrong direction). L elbow at y=0.884 — way above L knee y=0.064.

regression_risk: Medium — 6 field changes including PR-v4 shoulder revert (high confidence, same pattern as batch 1 cross-ankle-sit critical fix) + hips sign flip (clearcut from description). Re-render verification REQUIRED to confirm (1) L wrist actually reaches near L knee (target 3D dist <0.30 — geometrically marginal since L shoulder-to-L-knee distance 0.76 vs arm span 0.754), (2) pelvis shift to R side doesn't break R leg planted position.
rationale: Description: STANDING lean with one foot on tube, forearm resting on bent knee. PR-v4 forced shoulders to -110 (overhead) as too-subtle auto-fix — wrong direction for forearm-on-knee contact. Same defect class as cross-ankle-sit (batch 1) and p15-chair-s6 (this batch). Fixes: (1) L arm — drop shoulder abduction -110→-25 (overhead → ~30°, arm angled down toward knee), flip shoulderFwd +15→-20 (positive=BEHIND per corrected convention was wrong direction; negative=FORWARD reaches toward L knee), elbow 85→90 (right-angle forearm horizontal on knee). Target: L wrist near L knee (0.322, 0.064, 0.174), 3D distance <0.30. (2) R arm — drop shoulder -110→-15 (arm at side, not overhead; description doesn't specify R arm but default is relaxed at side), shoulderFwd 5→0 (neutral). (3) Pelvis — flip hips +15→-15 (sign wrong: was left-hip-lower but standing leg is R, need right-hip-lower for R weight-bearing per description). Legs preserved (L hip 95° flexed with foot on tube, R hip 5° straight standing). Sign conventions verified.
